title: HB 2067 (2011-2012 Regular Session (2011 session)): Voter photographic identification requirements. (short title on legislature page); AN ACT concerning elections; relating to voter identification; amending K.S.A. 25-2411, 25-2416, 25-2423 and 25-2431 and K.S.A. 2010 Supp. 8-1324, 25-1122, 25-1122d, 25-1123, 25-1124, 25-1128, 25-2309, 25-2908, 25-3002 and 65-2418 and repealing the existing sections. (as introduced)
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) K.S.A. 25-2908(h)(1) as amended by Sec. 11 (Enrolled HB 2067)
(quote) The following forms of identification shall be valid if the identification contains the name and photograph of the voter and has not expired. Expired documents shall be valid if the bearer of the document is 65 years of age or older:
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) K.S.A. 25-2908(h)(2) as amended by Sec. 11 (Enrolled HB 2067)
(quote) If the person fails to furnish the identification required by this subsection, the person shall be allowed to vote a provisional ballot. The canvassing board shall determine the validity of the ballot pursuant to K.S.A. 25-3002, and amendments thereto.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) K.S.A. 25-1122(e)(1) as amended by Sec. 2 (Enrolled HB 2067)
(quote) (e) No county election officer shall provide an advance voting ballot to a person who is requesting an advance voting ballot to be transmitted by mail unless: (1) The county election official verifies that the signature of the person matches that on file in the county voter registration records.
(section) K.S.A. 25-1122(e)(2) as amended by Sec. 2 (Enrolled HB 2067)
(quote) (2) the person provides such person’s full Kansas driver’s license number, Kansas nondriver’s identification card number issued by the division of vehicles, or submits such person’s application for an advance voting ballot and a copy of identification provided by K.S.A. 25-2908, and amendments thereto, to the county election officer for verification.
(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) K.S.A. 25-2309(l) as amended by Sec. 8 (Enrolled HB 2067)
(quote) (l) The county election officer or secretary of state’s office shall accept any completed application for registration, but an applicant shall not be registered until the applicant has provided satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship.
(section) K.S.A. 25-2309(l) list, as amended by Sec. 8
(quote) Evidence of United States citizenship shall be satisfied by providing one of the following, or a legible photocopy of one of the following documents:
(e_other_rule)
(section) K.S.A. 25-2908(i) as amended by Sec. 11 (exemptions)
(quote) The following persons are exempt from the photographic identification document requirements of this section:
(section) K.S.A. 8-1324 as amended by Sec. 1 (free nondriver ID for voting)
(quote) shall not require or accept payment of application or photo fees under this subsection for any person 17 years of age or older for purposes of meeting the voter identification requirements of K.S.A. 25-2908, and amendments thereto.
(section) Sec. 22 (effective date)
(quote) This act shall take effect and be in force from and after January 1, 2012, and its publication in the statute book.
(other) Sec. 1 (K.S.A. 8-1324): free nondriver identification card for a voter who swears the voter has no acceptable ID and shows voter registration; photo ID and lawful-presence rules for ID cards.
(other) Sec. 2-6 (K.S.A. 25-1122, 25-1122d, 25-1123, 25-1124, 25-1128): advance voting; ID or ID number with advance-ballot applications; signature verification; provisional ballot if ID not provided.
(other) Sec. 8 (K.S.A. 25-2309): registration application contents; documentary proof of United States citizenship to register; 13 qualifying document types; appeal by assessment of other evidence.
(other) Sec. 11 (K.S.A. 25-2908): ID requirement at the polls for every voter at every election; exemptions.
(other) Sec. 12-13, 14-15, 16-19: canvass of provisional ballots (25-3002); birth-certificate fee waiver (65-2418); voter education notice; other election-code conforming changes.
